issues.title: Dangling External References (Truncation)
issues.why: The module delegates all per-script logic to 50+ external files (01-*.md, etc.) which are truncated by the context cap. A mediocre AI cannot implement the actual tool logic (e.g., the specific regex for cross-links or the logic for tree-health) without these files.
issues.fix: The spec acknowledges this via 'Walker-Pin' and 'Slot Delegation Map' to provide high-level context, but for 100% implementation confidence, the specific script specs must be provided or the logic inlined.

issues.title: Truncated Acceptance Criteria (AC-11-05)
issues.why: The file 11-generate-dashboard-data.md ends mid-sentence in AC-11-05 due to the 136KB cap, leaving the 'Verifies' clause and final logic for inline-code blanking undefined.
issues.fix: Move detailed implementation logic for generators into their specific slot files and keep the overview/AC files leaner to stay under the 120KB-140KB walker budget.

issues.title: Concurrency/Locking Implementation Ambiguity
issues.why: While R2 provides code snippets, it doesn't explicitly state if *all* scripts must use this for *all* file reads, or only for the specific 'generated artifacts' listed in AC-T-32.
issues.fix: Clarify in AC-T-28 that R2 applies to any file read that is subject to concurrent writes by other toolchain members.
